greeting: Morning, Dan. A calm Sunday with the girls around — a 9 o'clock review with Mike and a 5 o'clock island meeting bracket a wide-open afternoon.

needsAttention.title: DIRA & DIBA meeting — Mark needs to know if you're in
needsAttention.detail: Mark Hoffman wrote yesterday asking whether you're attending today's 5 PM annual meeting; if not, he needs your proxy for quorum. You've accepted the invite, so a one-line yes to Mark settles it.

needsAttention.title: Read the annual-meeting materials before you join
needsAttention.detail: David Wetherbee's packet for the Bridge and Road associations has been sitting in your inbox since Oct 2. A quick skim before the 5 PM Zoom is the difference between voting and just listening.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental this week
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. It's been flagged p1 since Sep 14 — book refundable at today's review and the risk is gone.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December-break destination
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by was Sep 30 and the book-by was Oct 15, both now past, for six people over three weeks of the thinnest holiday inventory. Pick domestic-vs-international today so booking can actually happen.

acts.line: The 9 o'clock review with Mike is the one lever on the whole board — fifteen minutes to put owners and dates on what's drifted.
Nothing scheduled and the girls are home — the long middle is yours to spend as you like.
The island associations' annual meeting closes the day at five; an hour on Zoom, then it's quiet.
